items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I think for me what I fall back on is what Duke Ellington said about music, there’s only two types of music: good music and bad music.

ctx.x: Do you have a description of what it is you’re trying to do with your music?

Hmm. That’s an interesting question, a description. I would hope that it would be fresh. I hope that — I think for me what I fall back on is what Duke Ellington said about music, there’s only two types of music: good music and bad music. I really believe that to be true. And not so much bad music but something that maybe you don’t like. And you know there’s all kinds of things that I may not really like that I listen to and I’ll check out like a student of mine or a friend of mine who may be listening to…
You do a certain amount of composing?
